entries.name: Thing
entries.notes: Explicit Thing boundaries retain concrete runtime types. Typed reads validate full element types and callable signatures. No implicit coercion or dynamic arithmetic.

entries.name: Byte
entries.notes: The configured Byte/Bytes family is recognized, but only Bytes has owned storage. Singular Byte has no scalar source type or one-byte constructor. Octet reads produce Number.

entries.name: Bytes
entries.notes: Owned byte sequences construct from Text, snapshot and support checked indexed reads as Number. Byte mutation and numeric-width families are not supplied.

entries.name: Pointer
entries.notes: Managed typed handles share targets. Reads snapshot ordinary contents. Checked mutation rejects ownership cycles, including container and callable-environment edges. No pointer arithmetic or raw-address API.

entries.name: Null
entries.notes: Null initializes an explicit absence value. Typed reads preserve evaluation and type/index/key checks. Unassigned storage and the native-definition Null atom remain separate.

entries.name: List
entries.notes: Typed owned Lists construct, append, replace and read indexed values. Heterogeneous construction infers Thing without coercion. Indices and complete element types are checked. Iteration/removal remain outside this API.

entries.name: Dictionary
entries.notes: Dictionary owns lexical members, exports and canonical alias identity. It is a source namespace, not runtime key/value storage. Use Map for that distinct meaning.

entries.name: Service
entries.notes: Service declarations remain structural. Standalone bodies, packages and native process operations are unsupported. App-constructed Service libraries retain their workspace topology. Static inspection. Witnesses not run.

entries.name: Attribute
entries.notes: Recognized applicational category and internal Function/Object attributes are implemented. No standalone New Attribute source data-field or runtime-value constructor is supplied.

entries.name: Definition
entries.notes: Framed definitions attach to words and composed Functions. The recognized Definition category has no standalone New Definition source constructor for a runtime value to store or inspect.

entries.name: Function
entries.notes: Functions bind typed invocation verbs and private bodies. Signatures include canonical constructor identity. Aliases preserve it and incompatible transfers reject. Emission uses selected builtin/logeme definitions. The callable type and builtin composition use the same selected Function constructor. Canonical word prose is associated explicitly rather than duplicated.

entries.name: Adjective
entries.notes: Descriptors retain canonical targets through aliases and qualified imports. Source nouns bind typed formals and fixed operands to selected constructors. Replacements consume original operands. Wrappers name and preserve the base result. Operands evaluate once in authored order. Native moves and borrows remain checked. This is not a resource-cost certificate.

entries.name: Adverb
entries.notes: Configured visibility, negation, comparison and progression roles work. General application of a newly authored Adverb body to an action is not implemented. Lexical recognition does not establish that capability.

entries.name: Thing
entries.notes: Internal representation tag. Source constructors, typed storage and ownership are implemented separately from raw primitive/native-definition encoding.

entries.name: Process
entries.notes: Ordered source operations use the shared instruction path. Provisional input labels acquire their actual Process scope before semantic use and cannot shadow enclosing Function parameters or escape into siblings. Explicit annotations preserve declared types and dependencies for native type and borrow checking. No callable outputs or closure runtime are added.

entries.name: Function
entries.notes: The canonical Function definition supplies composed signatures and Process bodies for source declarations and constructed Objects.

entries.name: Function.Return
entries.notes: Root-authored returning actions use their caller’s selected Return. Its implementation keeps lexical delegates; Function-owned Returns retain their constructor contract and reject incompatible callers. Known unconditional source-actor and transparent-Process exits terminate typed caller flow. Real Function calls, conditional and opaque bodies retain their own boundaries and native obligations.

entries.name: Retain
entries.notes: Core Retain consumes a borrowed Arc and returns another handle to the same allocation without cloning its payload. The App source wrapper delegates to core Retain without lifecycle effects. Storage.Retain remains Rc-based. Atomic ownership does not certify payload Send/Sync or destructor costs.

entries.name: Main
entries.notes: Source-defined Service/Object/Function construction descriptor used by Apps. It grants no standalone Service process role.

entries.name: Generic
entries.notes: Native source constructors accept explicit ordered parameter atoms through their declared slots. GenericTypes and Lifetimes retain their approved local native-input contract. This does not infer parameters or introduce general L generics.

entries.name: Input
entries.notes: Input metadata covers Function parameters and scoped structured Process bindings. No App process input transport is supplied.

entries.name: Put
entries.notes: Typed updates append/replace List elements, write Map values or replace a Pointer target. Destination kind, keys, element types and managed ownership cycles are checked.

entries.name: Place
entries.notes: Typed updates append/replace List elements, write Map values or replace a Pointer target. Destination kind, keys, element types and managed ownership cycles are checked.

entries.name: Get
entries.notes: The configured receptive root parses but has no native instruction role or bound implementation. A public Compile probe of Get 0 from items rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.receptive. The matched typed read control compiles.

entries.name: Take
entries.notes: The configured reductive root has no native instruction role or bound implementation. A public Compile probe of Take 0 from items reaches unsupported outer instruction action action.reductive. This is known unavailability, not unresolved semantics.

entries.name: Import
entries.notes: The configured inflective action is not the source loader. A public Compile probe of Import `io` rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.inflective while Use IO from `io` compiles.

entries.name: Export
entries.notes: The configured deflective action has no lowering implementation. A public Compile probe of Export `io` rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.deflective. Public/Publicly publish declarations. They are not runtime Export aliases.

entries.name: IO
entries.notes: Reviewed registered export namespace for dictionary language=eng key=io. Index-driven addition/rename/deletion must trigger new review.

entries.name: IO.Print
entries.notes: Print retains Render then private Write. Write obtains one stdout guard, invokes the source Lined Sender and applies shared Result.Expect with the existing failure message. Bytes, formatting and LF policy remain unchanged.
entries.effect: Writes the selected typed rendering and appends LF; no L return value is declared.

entries.name: IO.Output
entries.notes: One selected std::io::stdout call. Resource identity does not establish authority or isolation.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Obtains the standard-output handle; does not lock, write or flush.

entries.name: IO.Diagnostic
entries.notes: One selected std::io::stderr call. It supplies an alternate native writer handle without adding an input or networking API.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Obtains the standard-error handle; does not redirect Print.

entries.name: IO.Send
entries.notes: The source Function composes a borrowed byte view with write_all. Its native operation handles short writes and Interrupted, and rejects zero progress with WriteZero. L adds no extra retry policy. A failure can follow partial output. Allocation and blocking remain native obligations.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Writes the borrowed byte view and returns std::io::Result<()>; no added LF, lock, flush or panic.

entries.name: IO.Lined
entries.notes: Targets the actual derived Sender. Its private L-authored helper selects the retained Result. Base evaluation, generic arguments, result binding and helper provenance are preserved. It adds no output transaction or lifecycle operation.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: After payload success, sends LF through the same writer; returns the first error or unit success.

entries.name: IO.Flush
entries.notes: One Write::flush call. Flushing may block or fail and does not establish durable storage.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Requests an explicit native writer flush and returns its IO Result.

entries.name: Render / Write
entries.notes: Render, Write, Lock, byte view and line-completion source helpers remain private dependencies. Stream, Check and Slice have no compatibility aliases. Public byte IO is classified separately.

entries.name: Invalid zero sentinel
entries.notes: The unnamed zero value is a compiler sentinel. It is not one of the 23 named representation tags or a public source constructor. valueTypeCount is an enum bound, not a stored value. Static inspection only.

entries.name: Map
entries.notes: Owned typed values keyed by Text bytes. Insertion/replacement and checked reads preserve complete element types and deterministic byte ordering. Distinct from a vocabulary Dictionary.

entries.name: Map
entries.notes: Internal representation tag. Executable source semantics are defined by the linked runtime type contract.

entries.name: Error
entries.notes: Error values can be constructed, stored, captured and placed in typed containers. App Error is optional until inspected. Extracting an absent Error rejects. Direct Show remains unsupported.

entries.name: runtime-captures
entries.notes: Activation-specific environments snapshot ordinary captures and retain shared Pointer targets. Actual arguments evaluate once in caller scope before callee entry. Copies retain environments until last-owner release. App-process capture transport is not inferred.

entries.name: Storage
entries.notes: Explicitly importable implementation vocabulary, not implicit builtin or ordinary application vocabulary. Source compositions own typed traversal, result binding, lazy failures, release sequencing, byte appends and caller returns. Native allocation, blocking and destructor costs remain separate obligations.

entries.name: Runtime
entries.notes: Source implementation vocabulary selected through canonical dependencies. This is distinct from public application vocabulary. Runtime privately imports canonical Storage leaves and the shared Formatting implementation. Native host/platform inputs and generated composition retain separate ownership.

entries.name: Formatting
entries.notes: IO and Runtime select one canonical Formatting Function. Shared bindings, control and numeric operators use Storage. Private Integer/Wide/Indexed/Unsigned preserve their nominal targets and compose through Storage.Integral without intermediate narrowing. No Numeric dictionary or implicit arithmetic vocabulary is added. Formatting and IO do not source-load process supervision.

entries.name: Function.Invoke
entries.notes: Selected Function invocation uses resolved native target and ordered argument atoms. Callers normally use their Function invocation verb.

entries.name: Delegate
entries.notes: Selected native entry delegation receives a compiler-resolved reference and is the sole entry tail call. Quoted Text is not a native target-reference API.

entries.name: It
entries.notes: Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.

entries.name: That
entries.notes: Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.

entries.name: This
entries.notes: Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.

entries.name: Is
entries.notes: Assignment and same-type scalar equality/inequality are implemented. Definite assignment and rejection of mixed or non-scalar comparisons enforce the documented meaning rather than mark it unfinished.

entries.name: Have
entries.notes: Has tests the selected App Error, including same-App ownership. General collection membership is a different, unclaimed operation.

entries.name: Equal
entries.notes: Equality of matching Text, Number and Truth operands is implemented. No coercion or arbitrary object equality is promised.

entries.name: Not
entries.notes: Condition-owned negation is implemented by instructionCondition.Negated and native condition emission. Lack of joined conditions is an And/Or/If limitation, not a missing unary negation implementation.

entries.name: Less
entries.notes: Numeric strict and inclusive comparison are implemented. Rejecting Text ordering is the declared Number-operand contract.

entries.name: Greater
entries.notes: Numeric strict and inclusive comparison are implemented. Rejecting Text ordering is the declared Number-operand contract.

entries.name: Then
entries.notes: And then preserves composed action order. Source-action expansion evaluates each complete body before the next coordinated operand. It is a sequencing token, not an asynchronous scheduling feature.

entries.name: As
entries.notes: Declaration construction, aliases, typed parameters and invocation result names use the selected owning grammar and canonical binding. No standalone conversion operation is claimed.

entries.name: Of
entries.notes: Element types/contents and Function signature components are implemented through owner-specific construction and signature extraction.

entries.name: At
entries.notes: Checked reads and updates bind Number indices or Text keys and retain the selected container and result types. Key and bounds checks are intended behavior.

entries.name: With
entries.notes: Function signatures and descriptor-associated child constructions use With under their selected owners. It does not erase argument or descriptor contracts.

entries.name: In
entries.notes: List/Map/Pointer update destinations are lowered and type checked. In has no unclaimed lexical-namespace behavior.

entries.name: Out
entries.notes: Generic Function argument phrases accept Out and bind an ordinary argument. The configured consignment.deflective role has no dedicated grammar phrase or executable deflective/output/export operation. Accepting a PREPOSITION in a generic call does not implement that missing role.

entries.name: By
entries.notes: Generic Function argument phrases accept By and bind an ordinary argument. The configured phrase.indicative describes by Actor but no enclosing clause references that phrase to implement actor/passive execution. Generic separator acceptance does not implement that missing role.

entries.name: From
entries.notes: Indexed/file import sources and checked typed-read sources are implemented by their distinct owners. Provider isolation and read typing are enforced contracts.

entries.name: To
entries.notes: Native definition utilization, Function prepositional arguments and inclusive comparison phrases have their documented owner-specific implementations. To has no independent conversion/callback meaning.

entries.name: Than
entries.notes: Than supplies the comparison relationship in implemented numeric strict and inclusive conditions. Matching Number typing is intentional.

entries.name: For
entries.notes: For introduces the source-action body. Source instructions expand the selected action with scoped arguments in declared order. It does not introduce a general loop construct.

entries.name: Any
entries.notes: Any introduces typed source-action parameters or exact descriptor targets. Canonical target checking and rejection of ambiguous antecedents implement its contract, without unrestricted native generic promises.

entries.name: No
entries.notes: Explicit empty Function Inputs/Outputs and grammar-owned condition negation are implemented. No does not supply implicit initialization.

entries.name: A
entries.notes: A/An indefinite article family participates in implemented declarations, constructions and Error conditions. It need not select a type independently of its noun.

entries.name: The
entries.notes: The selects a definite subject/value in its existing lexical context. App body effects and member Function invocations have maintained witnesses. Visibility rejection is the contract.

entries.name: And
entries.notes: Operand/declaration/action coordination works, but recognized And-joined conditions are explicitly rejected by instructionBuilder.conditional because no Boolean join operator is implemented.

entries.name: Or
entries.notes: Canonical descriptor target alternatives work, but recognized Or-joined conditions are explicitly rejected by instructionBuilder.conditional because no Boolean join operator is implemented.

entries.name: If
entries.notes: Single typed conditions produce branches with flow checks. Recognized joined conditions reject during instruction lowering and configured else-if continuation rejects during grammar processing.

entries.name: Else
entries.notes: Plain Else works, but the configured conditional.else.if continuation does not parse as an executable chain. Actual valid single-if/else control passes while else-if leaves unassociated else tokens.

entries.name: Otherwise
entries.notes: Otherwise attaches to the immediately preceding unmatched conditional within the same paragraph. Intervening instructions or paragraph boundaries correctly reject. They are ownership rules rather than missing support.

entries.name: While
entries.notes: The configured While loop has no outer instruction implementation: instructionBuilder.statement accepts only if/else/other. The documented While fragment additionally fails grammar processing. Do not claim this fixture reaches lowering or that every possible configured While spelling was probed.

entries.name: Storage.Option
entries.notes: Dictionary namespace for native Option operations. This is not an L runtime carrier type.

entries.name: Storage.Result
entries.notes: Dictionary namespace for native Result operations. Native payload and error types remain explicit.

entries.name: Storage.Option.Select
entries.notes: Evaluate the supplied Option once. Choose a typed Some Process or payload-free None Process without cloning.

entries.name: Storage.Result.Select
entries.notes: Evaluate the supplied Result once. Choose a typed Ok or Err Process within the enclosing Function.

entries.name: Storage.Require
entries.notes: Consume Option<T> and &str. Preserve success payload or construct runtime failure only for None. Argument evaluation remains ordinary.

entries.name: Storage.Result.Expect
entries.notes: Consume a native Result and &str. Preserve successful payload or panic using native expect formatting.
